messages:
maya: Kicking off air-gapped APAC on-prem bring-up for ACME. Target: private VPC, 4x A100 nodes, no outbound 443 allowed. I uploaded a compact runbook and will post the checklist below. (seed courier ETA 2026-03-28 02:00UTC)
toby: thanks — what's the plan for delivering the seed bundle? physical courier or temporary egress tunnel?
maya: customer prohibits outbound, so physical courier with encrypted USB bundle and tamper tape. We'll prepare: images.tar.gz, manifests.tar.gz, images.sha256, cosign signatures, runtime tarballs (cuda/cudnn), and a short bootstrap script.
rachel: customer says they only allow specific source IPs on their firewall. We'll need a delivery window to exchange KMS pubkeys and fire up the seed console on-site. I can coordinate with their network team.
maya: checklist (high level):
1) Generate offline container archive: crane export ... -> images.tar.gz
2) Export k8s manifests: kustomize build overlays/onprem | tar -czf manifests.tar.gz
3) Package runtime artifacts (cuda, cudnn, nvidia driver installer) into runtimes.tar.gz
4) Sign artifacts with cosign and produce images.sha256
5) Test import on an airgap lab cluster identical to customer hardware
6) Courier handoff + on-site import + smoke tests.
toby: quick command refs (for the runbook):
```
# export images
crane export registry.redwood/internal/serve:1.2.3 --output images.tar.gz
# build manifests
kustomize build overlays/onprem > manifests.yaml
tar -czf manifests.tar.gz manifests.yaml
# generate checksums
sha256sum images.tar.gz > images.sha256
# sign image tag
cosign sign --key kpriv.pem registry.redwood/internal/serve:1.2.3
```
sameer: On networking — customer VPC is a /20, private transit with NAT and their internal NX routers. Proposed PodCIDR: 10.44.0.0/16 to avoid overlap. Confirm there's no overlapping with their existing database subnets. Also need to confirm MTU across the site (LOB wants jumbo frames).
sven: APAC transit has a known IPAM constraint — if we pick 10.44.0.0/16 verify no overlap with their edge proxies. I also measured that some switches drop >9000 MTU on certain uplinks; require MTU=9000 check before boot.
maya: Operational acceptance criteria for handoff (must pass before marking complete):
- All nodes kubelet Ready and GPU drivers loaded (nvidia-smi returns proper GPU list)
- All core Redwood components in namespace redwood-system Running
- Inference pods can schedule to GPU nodes (nodeSelector + tolerations)
- Perf smoke: single A100 baseline >=250 tokens/sec for a 512-token generation (cold start)
- No pod network overlap and pod->control-plane connectivity within <20ms median (inside site)
- Audit logs and KMS integration validated (cosign verify successful)
dan: cost note: physical courier + on-prem presence + additional pre-provisioning adds one-time ~$7k to the SOW. Finance wants explicit approval before we commit shipping.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist created (ops ticket): https://redwood-internal/ops/tickets/1851239876 - added runbook artifacts and acceptance criteria.
rachel: I'll take the network validation tasks and schedule the firewall window with the customer. Tagging local field engineer to confirm cabling and NIC firmware.
maya: On import, on-site eng runs: 
```
# import into local registry and verify
scp /media/seed/images.tar.gz registry:~/
ssh registry 'mkdir -p /var/lib/registry/import && tar -xzf ~/images.tar.gz -C /var/lib/registry/import'
# import into containerd
ctr -n k8s.io images import /var/lib/registry/import/*.tar
sha256sum -c /var/lib/registry/import/images.sha256
cosign verify --key /etc/redwood/keys/kpub.pem registry.local/redwood/serve:1.2.3
```
toby: also remember to stage quantized variants (loc-quant-8bit) in the offline registry as a fallback if runtime memory pressure or performance regressions appear.
sameer: Health checks post-import: 
- kubectl get nodes -> STATUS Ready for all GPU nodes
- kubectl -n redwood-system get pods -> all core components Running
- run `nvidia-smi` on each node and confirm driver >=525 and MIG profile availability if configured
- run a short inference smoke harness: `python tools/smoke.py --model redwood/serve:1.2.3 --tokens 512 --workers 2`
- capture prometheus scrape of node exporter + NVML metrics for 10 minutes
sven: MTU confirmed 9000 on uplinks for the planned rack. I will push a firmware check to the onsite checklist.
maya: If any of the checks fail, fallback plan: revert to maintenance mode and load pre-approved model variant + open support channel with customer ops for re-provisioning window.
dan: Finance: pinged and approved provisional SOW hold. Will confirm by EOD.
infra-bot: handoff ticket updated -> status: seeded_bundle_ready. assignees: maya, rachel, toby.
rachel: Scheduling 1-hr handoff call for 2026-03-28 04:00UTC (post-courier arrival). On-site eng + customer NOC + security.
maya: tagging @oncall-eng-infra for the 24/7 window next week once we go live. Will update the calendar invite.
toby: ack
dan: noted, finance will follow-up
sven: verified MTU and NIC firmware check added to runbook
infra-bot: final: handoff status changed to "in-progress".
